q: Choose the correct sentence:
o: Hardly he had reached the station when the train left.
Hardly he reached the station when the train had left.
Hardly had he reached the station than the train left.
Hardly had he reached the station when the train left.
e: (Hardly had … when): inversion after 'hardly'; 'than' goes with 'no sooner'.

q: Fill in the blank: No sooner did the bell ring ___ the students rushed out.
Fill in the blank: 'Not only the teacher but also the students ___ present.'
e: (were): the verb agrees with the nearer subject.

q: Choose the correct form: The committee ___ divided in their opinions.
e: (are): a collective noun takes a plural verb when members act individually.

q: Choose the correct passive: 'Let him do the work.'
o: Let the work be done by him.
Let the work be did by him.
Let the work is done by him.
The work is let to be done by him.
e: (Let the work be done by him)

q: Change into indirect speech: He said, "Alas! I have lost my purse."
o: He exclaimed sadly that he had lost his purse.
He said that alas he has lost his purse.
He exclaimed that I had lost my purse.
He said sadly that he lost his purse alas.
e: (exclaimed sadly that he had lost his purse)

q: Choose the correct article usage:
o: He is the M.A. in English.
He is an M.A. in English.
He is a M.A. in English.
e: (an M.A.): 'M' is pronounced with a vowel sound.

q: Fill in the blank: I would rather you ___ now.
e: (left): 'would rather + subject' takes the past subjunctive.
